thread:
sam: FYI ran a conversational-query focused bring-up for v4-slim-int6 this AM. used a 15k holdout of chat-style snippets (turns 1-3).
tara: good call, conv short turns can be fragile post-quant. what metrics?
sam: recall@1/5, MRR, median_cosine_shift from float32 baseline, and norm collapse fraction (<5 norm). also did a knn precision sample (top1 precision).
wei: numbers?
sam: top-line:
- float32 v3 baseline: r@1=0.84, r@5=0.95, mrr=0.89, cos_shift=0.00, norm_collapse=0.02, top1_prec=0.87
- v4-slim-int6 (per-tensor sym): r@1=0.68, r@5=0.88, mrr=0.75, cos_shift=0.12, norm_collapse=0.18, top1_prec=0.70
ana: ouch. looks like short conv turns are losing semantic signal. did you try per-channel int8?
sam: queued int8-pc run. also tried a quick asymmetric clip on int6 for a subset (calib n=2k) which improved r@1 to 0.72 and reduced norm_collapse to 0.12.
devops-bot: job v4-slim-int8-pc-5076543210 started on gpu-pool-3 (est 20m)

tara: can you share the eval command and seed so we can repro?
sam: sure:
```
python eval/conv_onboard.py \
  --model v4-slim \
  --quant int6-pertensor \
  --holdout 15000 \
  --conv-turns 3 \
  --metrics r@1,r@5,mrr,cos_shift,norm_collapse,top1_prec \
  --seed 1337
```
wei: also check per-turn breakdown. sometimes turn1 is fine and later turns degrade more after quant.
sam: I have per-turn: int6 r@1 by turn = [0.71,0.66,0.62] vs float32 [0.86,0.82,0.79]. drop increases with turn index.
nana: that suggests accumulation/attenuation of features across turns. could be token-level clipping during avg-pooling or attention pooling differences post-quant.
tara: try per-channel int6 asymmetric + tiny bias-correction (per-channel) and re-evaluate. if int8-perchannel recovers, set that as default for conv workloads.
sam: int8-pc finished: r@1=0.79, r@5=0.93, mrr=0.85, cos_shift=0.02, norm_collapse=0.04, top1_prec=0.83
wei: nice recovery. still slightly below float32 but acceptable for many apps.
ana: what's latency/size tradeoff vs int6? we need numbers for cost gating.
sam: int6 model size ~43MB, int8-pc ~60MB. latency median: int6=6.2ms, int8-pc=7.8ms on our serving stack. cost delta ~+18% for int8-pc.
tara: propose this policy: default int8-perchannel for conv/short-turn workloads, keep int6 as ultra-low-cost opt-in for long-context static embeddings. add a conv-turn probe and per-turn r@1 threshold to onboarding gate.
wei: agree. also add automated norm_collapse alarm (if >0.10 for short-turn holdout) to the model catalog snapshot.
sam: will add PR with: eval args + seed logged to catalog, conv-turn probe, per-turn thresholds, and a small calibration step (2k conv snippets) used for asymmetric centering on int6 experiments.
devops-bot: job v4-slim-int8-pc-5076543210 finished (duration 19m)
ana: one more ask — include a small random sample of top-1 neighbor examples in the onboarding report so product reviewers can eyeball semantics.
sam: good idea. I'll include a 50-sample inspect csv and attach it to the model entry.
tara: thanks sam, this will help product decide where the cost vs quality inflection point is.
